installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# OPEN//77 dedicated server - Pterodactyl install / reinstall
set -e
apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq curl jq ca-certificates tar coreutils >/dev/null
mkdir -p /mnt/server && cd /mnt/server

cat > open77-update.sh <<'OPEN77_EOF'
#!/bin/bash
# OPEN//77 updater for Pterodactyl: fetches the latest server build from the official CDN,
# verifies its SHA-256 and lays it over the install without touching private state.
#
# Env:
#   OP77_CHANNEL   stable (default) | unstable
#   OP77_VERSION   latest (default) or an exact version, e.g. 2.31.21+op77.138 (pin)
#   AUTO_UPDATE    1 (default) / 0 — when 0, only installs if nothing is installed yet
#   OP77_FORCE     1 to reinstall even if the version already matches
#   SERVER_DIR     install directory (default: current directory)
# Needs curl, tar, sha256sum, sed; jq is optional (the runtime yolk has none).
set -euo pipefail

CDN="https://cdn.open77.dev/server"
CHANNEL="${OP77_CHANNEL:-stable}"
WANTED="${OP77_VERSION:-latest}"
DIR="${SERVER_DIR:-$PWD}"
MANIFEST="$DIR/package-manifest.json"

log() { printf '\033[1;36m[open77-egg]\033[0m %s\n' "$*"; }
die() { printf '\033[1;31m[open77-egg]\033[0m %s\n' "$*" >&2; exit 1; }

# The top-level "version" is the first one in both latest.json and package-manifest.json.
json_version() { sed -n 's/.*"version": *"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p' "$1" | head -n1; }

# A field of the linux-x64 build in latest.json.
build_field() { # $1 = latest.json, $2 = url|archiveSha256
    if command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        jq -r --arg k "$2" '.builds["linux-x64"][$k] // empty' "$1"
    else
        sed -n '/"linux-x64"/,/}/p' "$1" | sed -n "s/.*\"$2\": *\"\([^\"]*\)\".*/\1/p" | head -n1
    fi
}

# Shipped file paths of a package-manifest.json, one per line (pretty-printed or minified).
manifest_paths() { grep -oE '"path": *"[^"]*"' "$1" | cut -d'"' -f4; }

# "sha256  path" lines of a package-manifest.json, for sha256sum -c.
manifest_checklist() {
    grep -oE '"(path|sha256)": *"[^"]*"' "$1" \
        | awk -F'"' '$2 == "path" { p = $4 } $2 == "sha256" && p != "" { print $4 "  " p; p = "" }'
}

CURRENT=""
[[ -f "$MANIFEST" ]] && CURRENT="$(json_version "$MANIFEST")"
INSTALLED=0
[[ -x "$DIR/Open77.Server" && -n "$CURRENT" ]] && INSTALLED=1

if [[ "${AUTO_UPDATE:-1}" != "1" && $INSTALLED == 1 ]]; then
    log "Auto-update disabled, keeping $CURRENT"
    exit 0
fi

# Never /tmp: Wings mounts it as a small tmpfs (100 MB by default), the archive and its
# extraction need about 300 MB. The server volume has the room.
WORK="$DIR/.open77-egg/tmp"
rm -rf "$WORK" && mkdir -p "$WORK"
trap 'rm -rf "$WORK"' EXIT

if [[ "$WANTED" == "latest" || -z "$WANTED" ]]; then
    case "$CHANNEL" in
        stable)   MANIFEST_URL="$CDN/latest.json" ;;
        unstable) MANIFEST_URL="$CDN/unstable/latest.json" ;;
        *)        die "Unknown OP77_CHANNEL '$CHANNEL' (stable|unstable)" ;;
    esac
    if ! curl -fsSL --retry 3 --max-time 30 "$MANIFEST_URL" -o "$WORK/latest.json"; then
        [[ $INSTALLED == 1 ]] && { log "CDN unreachable, starting installed $CURRENT"; exit 0; }
        die "Cannot fetch $MANIFEST_URL"
    fi
    VERSION="$(json_version "$WORK/latest.json")"
    URL="$(build_field "$WORK/latest.json" url)"
    SHA="$(build_field "$WORK/latest.json" archiveSha256)"
    [[ -n "$SHA" ]] || die "Manifest has no archive hash for linux-x64, refusing an unverified download"
else
    VERSION="$WANTED"
    URL="$CDN/$VERSION/open77-server-$VERSION-linux-x64.tar.gz"
    SHA=""
fi
[[ -n "$VERSION" && -n "$URL" ]] || die "Manifest did not describe a linux-x64 build"

if [[ "$VERSION" == "$CURRENT" && $INSTALLED == 1 && "${OP77_FORCE:-0}" != "1" ]]; then
    # Runtime files outside resources/ are never edited by hand: a mismatch means a broken
    # install (interrupted copy, full disk), so it is reinstalled. Resources may be customised.
    if (cd "$DIR" && manifest_checklist package-manifest.json | grep -v '  resources/' \
            | sha256sum -c --quiet --strict >/dev/null 2>&1); then
        log "Up to date: $VERSION ($CHANNEL)"
        exit 0
    fi
    log "Installed runtime files are damaged, repairing $VERSION"
fi

log "Installing OPEN//77 server $VERSION (installed: ${CURRENT:-none})"
curl -fL --retry 3 --progress-bar "$URL" -o "$WORK/server.tar.gz" || die "Download failed: $URL"

if [[ -n "$SHA" ]]; then
    echo "$SHA  $WORK/server.tar.gz" | sha256sum -c --status || die "Archive SHA-256 mismatch, nothing applied"
    log "Archive SHA-256 verified"
else
    log "Pinned version: no CDN archive hash, relying on the per-file hashes of package-manifest.json"
fi

mkdir -p "$WORK/stage"
tar -xzf "$WORK/server.tar.gz" -C "$WORK/stage" --no-same-owner
rm -f "$WORK/server.tar.gz"
[[ -x "$WORK/stage/Open77.Server" && -f "$WORK/stage/package-manifest.json" ]] \
    || die "Archive layout unexpected (Open77.Server or package-manifest.json missing)"

# Check every staged file before anything in the install is touched.
(cd "$WORK/stage" && manifest_checklist package-manifest.json | sha256sum -c --quiet --strict) \
    || die "A file of the archive does not match package-manifest.json, nothing applied"

# The archive never ships these, but guard them anyway: they are the server's private state.
for f in server.jsonc acl.jsonc tunables.json server-icon.png .open77 .open77-egg; do
    rm -rf "${WORK:?}/stage/$f"
done

# Files the previous release shipped and this one no longer does. Only those are removed:
# Workshop resources, custom resources, resource data/ and logs were never in a manifest.
if [[ -f "$MANIFEST" ]]; then
    manifest_paths "$MANIFEST" | sort -u > "$WORK/old.txt"
    manifest_paths "$WORK/stage/package-manifest.json" | sort -u > "$WORK/new.txt"
    removed=0
    while IFS= read -r p; do
        [[ -z "$p" || "$p" == /* || "$p" == *..* ]] && continue
        rm -f -- "$DIR/$p" && removed=$((removed + 1))
    done < <(comm -23 "$WORK/old.txt" "$WORK/new.txt")
    (( removed > 0 )) && log "Removed $removed file(s) dropped by this release"
fi

cp -a "$WORK/stage/." "$DIR/"
chmod +x "$DIR/Open77.Server" "$DIR/start.sh" 2>/dev/null || true

(cd "$DIR" && manifest_checklist package-manifest.json | sha256sum -c --quiet --strict) \
    || die "Installed files do not match package-manifest.json (disk full?). Reinstall the server."

log "OPEN//77 server $VERSION ready"
OPEN77_EOF
chmod +x open77-update.sh

cat > open77-boot.sh <<'OPEN77_EOF'
#!/bin/bash
# OPEN//77 Pterodactyl entrypoint: update, then start the server bound to the panel allocations.
cd /home/container || exit 1

log()  { printf '\033[1;36m[open77-egg]\033[0m %s\n' "$*"; }
warn() { printf '\033[1;33m[open77-egg]\033[0m %s\n' "$*"; }

bash ./open77-update.sh || warn "Update step failed, trying to start the installed build"
[[ -x ./Open77.Server ]] || { warn "No server installed. Reinstall the server from the panel."; exit 1; }

GAME_PORT="${SERVER_PORT:-11778}"
DL_PORT="${DOWNLOAD_PORT:-$((GAME_PORT + 1))}"
PUBLIC="${PUBLIC_IP:-}"
# Wings exposes the allocation IP; 0.0.0.0 or a private address cannot be advertised to players.
[[ -z "$PUBLIC" && -n "${SERVER_IP:-}" && "$SERVER_IP" != "0.0.0.0" ]] && PUBLIC="$SERVER_IP"

# First start without a config: Warden onboarding wizard (PIN printed in this console).
if [[ ! -f server.jsonc ]]; then
    if [[ -z "${WARDEN_PORT:-}" ]]; then
        warn "No server.jsonc and no WARDEN_PORT: add a TCP allocation for the setup wizard,"
        warn "or set SETUP_MODE=headless and reinstall to generate the config automatically."
        exit 1
    fi
    log "First start: open http://${PUBLIC:-<server-ip>}:${WARDEN_PORT}/ and enter the PIN below."
    log "In the wizard use game port ${GAME_PORT}/UDP and download port ${DL_PORT}/TCP."
    export OP77_WARDEN_SETUP_LISTEN="http://0.0.0.0:${WARDEN_PORT}"
    exec ./Open77.Server --config server.jsonc
fi

[[ -z "${DOWNLOAD_PORT:-}" ]] && warn "DOWNLOAD_PORT empty, using ${DL_PORT}: that port must be one of this server's allocations."
[[ -z "$PUBLIC" ]] && warn "No public IP (set PUBLIC_IP): players outside this host cannot reach the game or downloads."

# Customer-side settings first.
ARGS=(--no-setup --config server.jsonc --log-level "${LOG_LEVEL:-info}")
[[ -n "${SERVER_NAME:-}" ]]     && ARGS+=(--name "$SERVER_NAME")
[[ -n "${VISIBILITY:-}" ]]      && ARGS+=(--visibility "$VISIBILITY")
[[ -n "${OP77_DATABASE_CONNECTION:-}" ]] && ARGS+=(--set "database.enabled=true")
[[ "${WORKSHOP:-1}" == "1" ]]   && ARGS+=(--set "warden.hubFileGatewayOrigin=https://files.open2077.net")

# Free-form extra arguments from the panel, split on spaces, never glob-expanded.
if [[ -n "${EXTRA_ARGS:-}" ]]; then
    read -r -a EXTRA <<< "$EXTRA_ARGS"
    ARGS+=("${EXTRA[@]}")
fi

# Host-enforced settings last: on the command line the last value of a field wins, so
# EXTRA_ARGS, server.jsonc or Warden can never move the ports, address or slot count.
ARGS+=(--port "$GAME_PORT")
ARGS+=(--set "resources.download.enabled=true" --set "resources.download.listenUrl=http://0.0.0.0:${DL_PORT}/")
[[ -n "$PUBLIC" ]] && ARGS+=(--public-ip "$PUBLIC")
# Resource URL given to players: an HTTPS reverse proxy / CDN when set, else plain HTTP on the allocation.
if [[ -n "${DOWNLOAD_PUBLIC_URL:-}" ]]; then
    ARGS+=(--set "resources.download.publicBaseUrl=${DOWNLOAD_PUBLIC_URL%/}/")
elif [[ -n "$PUBLIC" ]]; then
    ARGS+=(--set "resources.download.publicBaseUrl=http://${PUBLIC}:${DL_PORT}/")
fi
[[ -n "${MAX_PLAYERS:-}" ]]     && ARGS+=(--max-players "$MAX_PLAYERS")
if [[ -n "${WARDEN_PORT:-}" ]]; then
    ARGS+=(--set "warden.enabled=true" --set "warden.listenUrl=http://0.0.0.0:${WARDEN_PORT}")
fi

log "Starting: ./Open77.Server ${ARGS[*]}"
exec ./Open77.Server "${ARGS[@]}"
OPEN77_EOF
chmod +x open77-boot.sh

cat > open77-genconfig.sh <<'OPEN77_EOF'
#!/bin/bash
# Writes a minimal server.jsonc for headless installs (SETUP_MODE=headless).
# Ports, public IP and player count are overridden at every boot by open77-boot.sh.
set -euo pipefail
DIR="${SERVER_DIR:-$PWD}"
cd "$DIR"
[[ -f server.jsonc ]] && { echo "[open77-egg] server.jsonc exists, leaving it untouched"; exit 0; }

TEMPLATE="${OP77_TEMPLATE:-freeroam}"
[[ -f "templates/$TEMPLATE/template.json" ]] || { echo "[open77-egg] Unknown template '$TEMPLATE'" >&2; exit 1; }

# Template lists resource names; package-manifest.json maps them to directories under resources/.
LOAD="$(jq -c --slurpfile m package-manifest.json '[.resources[] | $m[0].resources[.] // .]' "templates/$TEMPLATE/template.json")"
TAGS="$(jq -c '.defaultTags // []' "templates/$TEMPLATE/template.json")"

jq -n \
  --arg name "${SERVER_NAME:-OPEN//77 server}" \
  --arg desc "${SERVER_DESCRIPTION:-Hosted with Pterodactyl}" \
  --arg vis "${VISIBILITY:-Public}" \
  --argjson port "${SERVER_PORT:-11778}" \
  --argjson max "${MAX_PLAYERS:-32}" \
  --argjson load "$LOAD" \
  --argjson tags "$TAGS" \
'{
  "$schema": "./config/server.schema.json",
  schemaVersion: 1,
  identity: { name: $name, description: $desc, locale: "en", tags: $tags, visibility: $vis },
  network: { port: $port, publicEndpoint: null, maximumPlayers: $max },
  simulation: { tickRate: 30, snapshotRate: 20, expectedGameBuild: 23100, helloTimeoutSeconds: 10 },
  resources: { enabled: true, root: "resources", load: $load, autoStart: true },
  masterServer: { enabled: true, url: "https://master.open2077.net/", licenseKeyEnvironmentVariable: "OP77_LICENSE_KEY" }
}' > server.jsonc

echo "[open77-egg] server.jsonc generated from template '$TEMPLATE'"
OPEN77_EOF
chmod +x open77-genconfig.sh

# Reinstall always pulls again; server.jsonc, acl.jsonc, .open77/ and resource data are kept.
SERVER_DIR=/mnt/server OP77_FORCE=1 AUTO_UPDATE=1 bash ./open77-update.sh

if [[ "${SETUP_MODE:-wizard}" == "headless" ]]; then
    SERVER_DIR=/mnt/server bash ./open77-genconfig.sh
fi
echo "[open77-egg] Install complete"

variables.name: License key
variables.description: Platform license key (op77_live_...) from https://open2077.net/account/keys. Required for the server to appear on the master list.

variables.name: Update channel
variables.description: stable = production builds, unstable = test builds (newer client required).

variables.name: Version
variables.description: latest = always the newest build of the channel. Otherwise an exact version to pin, e.g. 2.31.21+op77.138.

variables.name: Auto update
variables.description: 1 = check the CDN and update on every start. 0 = never touch the installed build.

variables.name: Setup mode
variables.description: wizard = first start opens Warden onboarding (PIN in the console, needs Warden port). headless = install writes server.jsonc from the template (reinstall to apply).

variables.name: Template (headless)
variables.description: Gamemode template under templates/ used by headless setup.

variables.name: Public IP
variables.description: Public IP players connect to. Empty = use the allocation IP (must not be 0.0.0.0). Set by the host.

variables.name: Resource download port
variables.description: TCP port of a second allocation for resource downloads. Empty = game port + 1 (must also be allocated). Set by the host.

variables.name: Download public URL
variables.description: Optional URL players download resources from, e.g. https://cdn.example.net/ behind a TLS reverse proxy pointing at the download port. Empty = http://PUBLIC_IP:DOWNLOAD_PORT/.

variables.name: Warden port
variables.description: TCP port of an extra allocation for the Warden web panel / setup wizard. Empty = disabled. Set by the host.

variables.name: Max players
variables.description: Overrides network.maximumPlayers at every start. Empty = value from server.jsonc. Set by the host (slot count).

variables.name: Server name
variables.description: Overrides identity.name at every start. Empty = value from server.jsonc / Warden.

variables.name: Visibility
variables.description: Public, Unlisted or Private. Empty = value from server.jsonc.

variables.name: Workshop installs
variables.description: 1 = allow installing Workshop creations from Warden (files.open2077.net).

variables.name: Database connection
variables.description: Optional MySQL/MariaDB connection string for persistence. Kept out of the command line.

variables.name: Extra arguments
variables.description: Appended to the command line, e.g. --set simulation.tickRate=60 --tick-rate 60.
